i020: Everything essential to keep your loved ones safe — nothing intrusive
i021: Evernear avoids bloated features. Every component is purpose-built to detect inactivity early, prevent false alarms, and notify family guardians right when needed.
i023: Tap 'I am OK' (weight 1.0) to reset your safety timer, or let passive device interactions like screen unlock, charging, and step count (weight 0.2–0.8) extend safety naturally.
i027: Deterministic lifecycle from INITIALIZING, ACTIVE, CHECK_IN_REQUIRED, GRACE_PERIOD to ALERT_TRIGGERED, ACKNOWLEDGED, and RESOLVED, paired with a non-diagnostic 0–100 operational risk score.
i029: Automatically freezes the safety countdown during nighttime sleep windows (e.g., 22:00 – 07:00) in each user's local IANA timezone, or pause monitoring anytime.
i031: Connect Monitored users and Guardians via a 48-hour QR code or 6-character code. Escalate alerts instantaneously via FCM Push, SMS, and Telegram.
i033: Evernear never tracks background GPS. Location coordinates are captured once only when you explicitly consent during a check-in or an escalated emergency incident.

i041: One application, two tailored experiences for every family role
i042: You can be both a Monitored person and a Guardian for aging parents or solo-living relatives — switching seamlessly inside a single account.
i044: Soothing breathing safety halo, oversized 'I am OK' check-in button, and disturbance-free nighttime Quiet Hours.
i046: Real-time dashboard displaying safety state, countdown timer, non-diagnostic 0–100 priority score, and 1-tap incident acknowledgement.
i048: When internet connectivity drops, check-ins and activity signals are queued locally with idempotency keys and flushed automatically upon reconnection.
i060: Every screen in Evernear follows Calm UX guidelines: warm colors, high-contrast typography, and effortless one-tap actions.
i062: Breathing safety halo and the 'I am OK' button right at the center of the screen.
i064: See at a glance who is safe, who needs a check-in, and operational priority scores.
i066: Scan a QR code or enter a 6-character code valid for 48 hours to link securely.
i068: Never wakes loved ones at night thanks to timezone-aware Quiet Hours.
i078: Three simple steps to set up a safety circle for your loved ones
i080: Sign up quickly with email and password. Choose the role of Protected Person or Guardian.
i082: Generate a QR invitation or 6-character code valid for 48 hours to establish a two-way guardian link.
i084: Configure check-in intervals, Grace Period, nighttime sleep windows, and alert channels (FCM, SMS, Telegram).
i086: What Evernear requests from Google, and how we use it
i087: Evernear offers 'Sign in with Google' so you and your family don't need another password. We request only the minimum identity scopes required to sign you in.
i089: Your Google name, email address, and profile picture are used solely to create or recognize your Evernear account (`openid`, `email`, `profile`).
i090: Zero access to Gmail, Drive, Contacts, or Calendar
i091: Evernear never requests restricted or sensitive Google scopes and cannot read any private files or emails in your Google account.
i092: Never sold, never used for advertising
i093: Google user data is never transferred to data brokers, ad networks, or third parties, and is never used for ad profiling.
i094: Full control and instant account deletion
i095: Revoke access anytime in your Google Account settings, or permanently delete your account immediately inside the Evernear app.
i097: Evernear's use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

i110: Keeping loved ones safe while keeping your data strictly yours
i111: Zero Camera, Zero Mic, Zero Background GPS
i112: Evernear never records audio, video, or continuous background location. Only minimal safety state signals are transmitted.
i114: Only Guardians explicitly approved by you via a mutual 48h pairing invitation can view your safety status.
i116: Location coordinates are captured once only when you explicitly consent during a check-in or emergency escalation.
i118: Device network pings (Heartbeat = 0.0) are used strictly for technical diagnostics and never reset your human safety timer.
i120: All REST API and real-time WebSocket traffic is encrypted over TLS. Passwords are one-way hashed with bcrypt and paired with rotating JWT refresh tokens.
i121: GDPR Right to Erasure & Instant Deletion
i122: Export your personal data or permanently erase your entire account, signals, and incidents immediately in-app (`DELETE /api/v1/users/me`).
del.title: Permanently delete your account and data anytime
del.desc: Evernear respects your right to erasure. Delete your account immediately inside the app or submit a request via our public web page if you no longer have your device.
del.inapp.title: 1. Instant In-App Deletion
del.inapp.desc: Open Evernear → Settings → Delete Account. This calls `DELETE /api/v1/users/me` to permanently erase your profile, devices, activity signals, check-ins, locations, and guardian links immediately.
del.web.title: 2. Web / Email Deletion Request
del.web.desc: If you uninstalled the app or lost your phone, visit our Account Deletion Request page to verify ownership by email. All eligible data is permanently erased within 30 days.
i125: Why does a phone Heartbeat have a weight of 0.0?
i126: A charged phone sitting on a table with Wi-Fi does not prove its owner is safe. Evernear strictly separates technical network pings (Heartbeat = 0.0) from real human activity (0.2–0.8) and explicit 'I am OK' check-ins (1.0).
i127: Will the app disturb seniors while they sleep at night?
i128: No. With Quiet Hours (Sleep Windows), the server countdown automatically freezes during configured sleeping hours (e.g., 22:00 to 07:00 in the user's local timezone) and resumes smoothly in the morning.
i129: How does location sharing work? Is GPS always on?
i130: No. Evernear never tracks continuous background GPS. Location is captured as a single-shot coordinate only when you grant permission and perform a check-in or when an emergency alert triggers.
i131: Is the Composite Risk Score (0–100) a medical diagnosis?
i132: Not at all. The 0–100 score is a non-diagnostic operational prioritization indicator based on check-in latency and signal history to help family guardians prioritize attention. Evernear is not a medical device.
i133: How do I permanently delete my account and personal data?
i134: You can permanently delete your account and all personal data at any time directly inside the Evernear app (Settings → Delete Account). Deletion takes effect immediately on our servers. If you no longer have your device, use our public Delete Account web page (/delete-account).
i135: More peace of mind for you, more independence for your loved ones
i136: Create an account, pair via a 48-hour QR code, and configure Quiet Hours in just a few minutes.
i139: Passive safety companion & calm check-in system for solo dwellers and loved ones living afar — built with Privacy-by-Default.
i_disclaimer: Evernear is a non-diagnostic family inactivity monitor and notification tool, and does not replace medical care or public emergency services (113, 114, 115, 911).
p.title: Privacy Policy — Evernear
p.desc: EverNear Privacy Policy: data collected, how we use it, sharing with guardians, retention & deletion, and GDPR/CCPA rights.
p007: Applies to the Evernear mobile and web applications. Last updated: October 15, 2026.
p008: Evernear is an inactivity monitor and safety check-in app for seniors and solo dwellers. Built on Privacy-by-Default: zero cameras, zero microphones, and zero continuous background GPS tracking. This policy explains what we collect, who can see it, and how you can permanently delete your data.
p023: Email address, one-way bcrypt-hashed password (we never store plaintext passwords), display name, phone number (optional), avatar, preferred interface language, IANA timezone, and role (Monitored or Guardian).
p025: In Monitored Mode, Evernear records explicit 'I am OK' check-ins (weight 1.0), and enabled passive activity events (screen unlock, charging, step count — weight 0.2 to 0.8). Technical device heartbeats (weight 0.0) record connectivity and battery status solely for diagnostics.
p027: Evernear never collects continuous background GPS. Single-shot coordinates are recorded only when you grant permission and explicitly check in or when an emergency incident escalates (`ALERT_TRIGGERED`) so your linked Guardians can assist you.
p033: Evernear supports Sign in with Google and Sign in with Apple so you can sign in securely without managing another password.
p035: For Google Sign-In, we request only basic identity scopes: openid, email, and profile (account identifier, email address, display name, and profile photo). For Sign in with Apple, we receive only your Apple user identifier, display name, and email or private relay address (@privaterelay.appleid.com).
p036: Evernear does not request any restricted or sensitive Google scopes.
p037: We have zero access to Gmail, Drive, Contacts, Calendar, or Photos, and cannot read or modify anything in your Google or Apple account.
p049: Evernear's use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.
p053: To operate the 8-state safety state machine — evaluating check-in deadlines, Grace Periods, and freezing countdowns during Quiet Hours.
p054: To deliver multi-channel reminders and alerts — sending FCM push notifications, SMS.
p055: To calculate the Operational Priority Risk Score (0–100) — helping Guardians prioritize response urgency (strictly non-medical and non-diagnostic).
p058: We never sell your personal data, and we display zero advertisements.
p060: Your approved Guardians — only people who completed two-way pairing via a 48-hour QR invite can view your safety status and receive your alerts.
p065: Your name, email, and profile picture — only when you choose Sign in with Google.
p_apple_desc: Apple User ID, display name, and email (or @privaterelay.appleid.com) — only when you choose Sign in with Apple.
p066: Delivers push notifications (check-in reminders, incident alerts) to your device and linked Guardians via device tokens.
p068: Delivers fallback emergency alerts via SMS or Telegram to the contact channels configured by Guardians.
p074: Passwords are hashed using bcrypt; sessions use short-lived JWT Access Tokens with rotating Refresh Tokens and device session validation.
p075: Account and monitoring configuration data are retained while your Evernear account remains active. When you delete your account, all personal profile data, devices, activity signals, check-ins, locations, and incidents are permanently erased.
p077: Under GDPR and applicable privacy laws, you have the right to view, update, export (`GET /api/v1/users/me/export`), revoke guardian links, or permanently erase your personal data. Contact us at support@erai.vn.
p079: You can permanently delete your account and all personal data at any time directly inside the Evernear app at: Settings → Delete Account. This invokes DELETE /api/v1/users/me and takes effect immediately, erasing your profile, devices, check-ins, passive signals, locations, and guardian relationships. If you no longer have your device, submit a request via our public Evernear Account Deletion Request page.
p084: All traffic between the app and server is encrypted over TLS (HTTPS / WSS).
p085: Passwords are hashed with bcrypt; authentication uses short-lived JWTs and rotating Refresh Tokens.
p086: All sensitive operations (updating schedules, acknowledging incidents, deleting accounts) enforce strict server-side authorization.
p091: If we make material changes to this policy, we will update the date at the top of this page and notify you in the app. Contact us at support@erai.vn.

d.web.h2: How to request deletion via Web / Email
d.web.step1: Send an email from the address associated with your Evernear account to support@erai.vn.
d.web.step2: Use the subject line “Evernear Account Deletion Request” and include your display name. Never send your password or authentication tokens.
d.web.step3: We verify account ownership via email, permanently erase your data, and confirm completion within 30 days.
d.what.h2: Data that will be permanently deleted
d.what.p: Your entire account, personal profile, registered devices, monitoring configurations, Quiet Hours schedules, check-in history, passive activity signals, single-shot locations, incident history, notification channels, and guardian relationships.
d.keep.h2: Data that may be temporarily retained
d.keep.p: Minimal anonymized security audit logs may be retained where required by law for fraud prevention and service security. Pre-existing encrypted database backups are overwritten through standard rotation cycles.
